description: The file defines interfaces (function prototypes) related to hardware health testing, specifically for getting and setting boolean parameters and retrieving string parameters in the context of the X_RDK_hwHealthTest object.

methods.name: hwHealthTest_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the hardware health test.

methods.name: hwHealthTest_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the hardware health test.

methods.name: hwHealthTest_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for the hardware health test.
